blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lead public prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro has admitted that things would have been different — in the decision to drop three out of four Articles of Impeachment — had Vice President Sara Duterte shown interest in her trial. Luistro said this in a press briefing on Tuesday when asked why the prosecution decided to drop Articles I, III, and IV — leaving Article II or the allegation of unexplained wealth and her failure to disclose these in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) as the lone case. “Siguro kung from the start nakita namin […]...
